selection_note: Coordinates and windows selected from independent event or stable-surface references before inspecting detector output. Labels remain provisional at pixel/AOI scale.

park-fire-event.label: Documented fire event; AOI change candidate requiring imagery review
park-fire-event.selection_basis: A 1 km square at CAL FIRE's published incident reference point. The fire began July 24, within the target week. This does not label every cell as burned.

references.supports: Incident start July 24, 2024 and reference coordinate [39.7789, -121.76168].
Independent Landsat observations on July 26 and July 27 show the regional fire and burn scar.

park-fire-pre-event.label: Pre-event control candidate; quiet conditions not established
park-fire-pre-event.selection_basis: Same square as the event case, ending before the documented July 24 start. Other ground, weather and vegetation changes still require review.

references.supports: The target window ends before the documented incident start. This alone is not evidence that all imagery is unchanged.

gobabeb-quiet-reference.label: Published stable-surface reference; full AOI and radar quiet conditions require review
gobabeb-quiet-reference.selection_basis: 200 m square centred on the GHNA instrument coordinates in De Vis et al. (2024) Section 2.1.1, using the same cutout width as Section 2.2.4. Select the earliest accepted Sentinel-2 matchup in Table 1 whose preceding rolling baseline starts after the first listed good Sentinel-2 matchup (June 8): July 13, 2022, in target July 11-18 and baseline June 13-July 11. Fixed before any detector result, without searching for a negative satellite output. Published surface stability and independently selected ground samples support a quiet-reference candidate; they do not certify every AOI cell, SAR stability, or equivalence to urban construction/transport land cover.

references.supports: GHNA instrument coordinates, stable gravel-plain surface, 200 m satellite cutout method, deployment from May 2022 and accepted July 13 Sentinel-2 / ground-instrument matchup. GHNA is distinct from the nearby GONA RadCalNet station.

Version 1.0.0 independent ground-reflectance sample files. Five fixed sequences on June 22/28/30, July 10 and July 13 were checksum-verified; all quality-valid common five-degree directions and excluded flags are retained in selection evidence.

salzbachtal-demolition.event_time_uncertainty: Contractor says around noon local; this approximate UTC reference annotates timing only and does not change production date filters.

references.supports: Operator lists dated July 2 intact/closed bridge, November 6 demolition and November 16 cleanup galleries in 2021; preparatory work began May 2017. Gallery images were not independently inspected.
Demolition contractor confirms both approximately 310 m bridge spans were demolished November 6, 2021 around noon local (approximately 11:00 UTC).

July 2022 environmental authority report, printed pages 8-10, documents protective works and before/after wastewater assets; asset persistence does not establish unchanged surfaces or whole-AOI quietness.
Modern rebuilt south bridge footprint version 19; locator only, not the surveyed 2021 demolition footprint.
Modern rebuilt north bridge footprint version 6; the union of these two footprints fixes the AOI center before detector output.

salzbachtal-demolition.label: Documented civilian bridge demolition; change candidate requiring imagery review
salzbachtal-demolition.selection_basis: 500 m square centered on the union-bound midpoint of OSM bridge footprints 499938151 v19 and 1229149143 v6 (modern geometry used only as locator). Target [2021-11-06, 2021-11-13) contains the independently documented November 6 demolition; baseline [2021-10-09, 2021-11-06) ends before the event day. Any event-day acquisition would need a timing annotation, not silent removal. Public metadata inventory finds no November 6 acquisitions. Preparatory works may affect the baseline; target includes staging/cleanup, not demolition alone. Frozen before detector output.

salzbachtal-pre-demolition.label: Same-AOI pre-demolition reference candidate; quiet ground truth unavailable
salzbachtal-pre-demolition.selection_basis: Same frozen 500 m square. Target [2021-10-23, 2021-10-30) contains the authority-dated October 27 photographs; baseline [2021-09-25, 2021-10-23). This independently dated anchor supports bridge presence, not whole-AOI stability. Documented preparatory earthworks and protective interventions prevent a quiet label. Independent acquisition-bracketing evidence covering the entire AOI remains missing. Do not score detector responses here as false positives.
